name: Fast selling Item
query:
SELECT 
    sii.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:150",
    i.item_name AS "Item Name::200",
    SUM(sii.qty) AS "Total Quantity Sold:Float:150",
    SUM(sii.amount) AS "Total Sales Value:Currency:150"
FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice Item` AS sii
JOIN 
    `tabSales Invoice` AS si ON sii.parent = si.name
JOIN 
    `tabItem` AS i ON sii.item_code = i.item_code
WHERE 
    si.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY 
    sii.item_code
ORDER BY 
    SUM(sii.qty) DESC
LIMIT 5
